jobs.description:
Opportunity

This is an office-based role. Candidates are expected to work from our office at least 4 days per week. Remote work is limited to 1 day per week.

Building reliable infrastructure from the inside

Reliable infrastructure is about more than keeping systems running. It means understanding how an environment works, solving problems at their source and creating systems that become easier to manage over time.As a System Engineer at ILIAS Solutions, you take ownership of the infrastructure behind our international organization. This is an internal IT position: you will not work directly with customers, but you will support the people who build, deliver, implement and support the ILIAS Defense Platform.You work across Linux systems, hybrid infrastructure and automation. Alongside day-to-day operations, you look for patterns: where recurring work can be automated, where configurations can become more consistent and where better documentation can make the environment easier to understand. The goal is clear: continue moving infrastructure from reactive support towards a structured, automated and predictable engineering environment.

Meaningful work

ILIAS develops software for demanding defense and security environments, and the people behind that work depend on reliable technology every day. As part of Internal IT, your impact is internal but reaches across the organization: you help create the technical foundation that enables development teams to build, implementation teams to deliver and support teams to help customers. When infrastructure is stable, secure and well managed, colleagues across Belgium, the Netherlands, Denmark and the United States can work with fewer disruptions and greater confidence.

Your Mission

What will you do?

• Manage and improve the internal server infrastructure that supports ILIAS employees across offices, teams and business functions.
• Take ownership of Linux system administration, including installation, configuration, maintenance, troubleshooting, patching and performance follow-up.
• Use Ansible to automate recurring work, standardize configurations and make infrastructure changes repeatable, traceable and less dependent on manual execution.
• Maintain Linux and Windows Server environments across VMware, Azure and on-premises infrastructure.
• Investigate complex infrastructure, system, software and network issues with an analytical mindset and a focus on sustainable solutions, not quick fixes only.
• Contribute to clear documentation, monitoring, backup routines, operational procedures and continuous improvement of internal IT processes.
• Support secure and reliable access to the internal systems and infrastructure services used by ILIAS colleagues every day.
• Work with the reliability, quality and security awareness expected from a company active in the defence domain and certified according to ISO 9001 and Cyber Essentials.
 

What you bring?

• Proven experience as a Linux System Administrator or System Engineer.
• Strong hands-on expertise in Linux server environments. Linux is not a side topic in this role; it is one of the core areas where we need depth.
• Solid experience with Ansible, including playbooks, automation and configuration management.
• Good knowledge of Azure and experience with cloud or hybrid infrastructure environments.
• Knowledge of VMware and Windows Server environments.
• A security-minded approach to infrastructure and operations.
• Strong analytical thinking skills: you can investigate issues thoroughly, identify root causes and explain your reasoning clearly.
• A predictable and transparent way of working: you document what you do, communicate clearly and keep colleagues informed before, during and after changes.
• The maturity to take ownership, challenge unclear requests, ask the right questions and work towards sustainable improvements.
• A degree in IT, Computer Science or equivalent experience.
• At least C1 level in Dutch and English.

Responsibilities

• Map current operational processes and design future-state operating models across multiple entities.
• Draft and maintain comprehensive functional specification dossiers to drive application migrations.
• Translate functional decisions into technical application requirements, including parameters, data mapping, and access rights.
• Lead workshops with various stakeholders to align local requirements with organizational standards.
• Coordinate with technical teams to implement changes in human resources and operational management systems.
• Define and execute test campaigns to validate application adaptations and data consistency after migration.
• Document strategic decisions and arbitration results to ensure full traceability throughout the project lifecycle.

Requirements

• 3+ years of experience in business and functional analysis using BPMN for process mapping.
• Possess strong expertise in stakeholder management within complex environments involving multiple parties.
• You have experience documenting data models, interfaces, and master data codification.
• You bring experience in designing and executing application test plans and validation strategies.
• 1+ years of experience managing or supporting data migration projects.
• 1+ years of experience working within the public sector.
• 1+ years of experience performing data queries and extraction using SQL and Python.
• You are proactive and solution-oriented with a strong analytical mindset.
• You are fluent in French, Dutch, and English.
Nice to Haves

• Previous experience in organizational mergers or large-scale restructuring projects.
• Knowledge of human resources management systems or local administration software.

Opportunity
Ensure the quality and reliability of our PLUS Platform .PLUS exists so ILIAS can focus on its core business. We take on the opportunities, challenges, and initiatives that require new thinking, new technology, or a different approach. By carrying part of the innovation, transformation, and operational load, we help the organisation move faster and prepare for what comes next. Adaptability is our superpower. We don't just respond to change, we work where ILIAS will be tomorrow.You focus on validating PLUS functionalities and ensuring that systems behave as expected in environments where quality and reliability matter.Meaningful Work in a Mission Driven EnvironmentYour work supports applications used in operational environments. You ensure that functionality, integrations, and business processes are reliable, consistent, and ready to support users and operational activities.The Impact You Help CreateYou improve application quality, reduce risk, and ensure that business-critical systems perform reliably. Your work supports consistent and trustworthy outcomes.

Your Mission
What you will do:• Design, execute, and maintain detailed test plans and test cases covering functional and non-functional testing• Perform integration, regression, and end-to-end testing activities• Identify, document, and track defects• Support test documentation and reporting• Work with development teams to resolve issues and improve quality• Contribute to structured testing processes and continuous improvement• Support automated testing activities What You Bring• Experience in manual and functional testing• Understanding of testing methodologies (ISTQB foundation level or similar knowledge)• Experience with test and defect management tools such as Jira, Spira, Xray, or similar• Analytical mindset and attention to detail• Strong communication skills in English• Ability to work independently and within a team• Knowledge of test automation tools such as Playwright or equivalent is a plus• Knowledge of API testing and Postman is a plusSystems Thinking and Analytical StrengthYou understand how business processes, application functionality and system behavior connect. You analyze outcomes and ensure that applications perform consistently across scenarios.Working Across Teams and FunctionsYou work in a small team with direct collaboration with developers, and others stakeholders, and ensure that quality is maintained across the development process.

jobs.occupation: DevSecOps & Cloud Security Engineer | Vacancy Brussels
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about building secure cloud environments and embedding security into every stage of software delivery? In this role, you will help shape a security-first culture by integrating security into development processes, strengthening cloud environments, and enabling teams to deliver resilient applications at scale.

What you'll do

• You design, build and maintain automated security controls within CI/CD pipelines, ensuring security is embedded throughout the software development lifecycle.
• Working closely with development, cloud and operations teams, you help implement security-by-design practices across AWS and Azure environments.
• You assess cloud security posture, identify risks and lead remediation efforts to improve compliance with security frameworks and benchmarks.
• You support the security of containerized platforms and infrastructure-as-code solutions by promoting secure configurations and automation.
• You provide expertise on secure coding standards, DevSecOps tooling and application security practices, helping teams strengthen their security maturity.
• By monitoring key security indicators and supporting incident investigations, you contribute to the continuous improvement of Luminus' cyber resilience. 

What you bring

• Proven experience in DevSecOps, cloud security or application security, with a strong understanding of CI/CD environments and security automation.
• Experience working with security technologies such as SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets management solutions, Terraform and software supply chain security practices.
• Strong knowledge of cloud and container technologies, including AWS, Azure, Kubernetes and related security concepts.
• Your understanding of application security principles, OWASP guidelines and vulnerability management enables you to identify and address security risks effectively.
• A collaborative mindset that allows you to work effectively with developers, cloud experts, project teams and external partners.
• Professional proficiency in English and fluency in Dutch and/or French.

We are looking for an experienced seamstress/seamster for a mattress manufacturing company in the Maldegem region!

What will your tasks be?

• You will be responsible for sewing covers and closing the mattresses.
As you gain more experience, we will teach you additional tasks step by step, such as:

• inserting zippers
• sewing on ribbons
• other finishing details

What do we expect from you? 

• You work accurately and contribute to a high-quality end product.
• You already have some experience with sewing or working on a sewing machine.
• You work precisely and are quality-oriented.
• You speak Dutch or English well!
• The job is mainly done standing up, so you must be physically able to do this.

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

Your role:

• You prepare and submit certification files to national authorities and certification bodies.
• You analyze quality standards, norms, customer specifications, contracts and aviation regulations and adapt internal procedures or manuals, or draft new procedures.
• You organize and supervise external audits of customers, authorities and certification organisations and handle the findings.
• You are part of the validation process of suppliers and subcontractors and monitor the process regarding the quality of the delivered products and services.
• You support the owners of the processes in dealing with quality deviations/findings, using quality basic techniques.
• You propose actions to improve the efficiency of the business processes.
• You prepare presentations and provide training to colleagues on quality topics.
• You participate in multidisciplinary projects.
• You conduct internal quality audits, provide reporting of findings and follow up on corrective actions.
• You assist in the statistical analysis of data and its reporting.
• You manage Non-Conformities at the Quality Level:
• Report any non-compliance and/or non-application of quality rules to management.
• Record and monitor quality deviations identified in products and processes, in accordance with the company's quality system.
• Analyze and catalog quality deviations relating to products and processes in order to statistically determine areas for improvement within the company.
• Raise awareness and provide guidance to all staff regarding quality management to ensure product compliance and the effective operation of company processes.
• Provide methodological support to management and/or process owners when addressing quality deviations in their area (using QMS tools).
• Independently validate the root causes of quality deviations as defined by process owners.
• Independently verify the effectiveness of corrective and remedial actions resulting from quality deviations.

Your profile:

• You have a Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical field, or equivalent through experience.
• You are fluent in Dutch, French and English.
• You are analytically and editorially minded.
• You are creative in finding solutions within the established framework.
• You can work independently and are committed to develop your knowledge through self-study and research.
• You are open minded, you work in a structured way and you can motivate people with regards to the quality and safety policy of the company.
• Additional qualifications that may help you in this role (but not a must have) include:
• Experience in quality and safety management in aviation
• Knowledge of standards and guidelines from national and international aviation authorities (EN9110, EASA part 145, etc)
• Knowledge of quality management systems
• Knowledge of aircraft engines, metrology
• Knowledge of process management
• Knowledge and ability to apply quality techniques and methodologies, such as problem solving techniques (8D, Ishikawa, flow charts, , ...), audit techniques.
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

For our client, a company in the Ghent region that operates in the steel industry, we are looking for an experienced and motivated Overhead Crane Operator.

Your tasks: 

• You will be responsible for lifting and moving steel plates using the overhead crane.
• You will work independently.
• You must not be afraid of heights and must have good depth perception.
• You have to load the trucks with metal parts.
• Correctly positioning the metal coils in the warehouse. 

Who are you?
• You speak English well
• You live within a 30-km radius of Evergem and have your own transport. 
• You enjoy working independently and do so effectively, are not afraid of heights, and have good depth perception.
• You are a hard worker.
• Experience as a crane operator.

The company processes ham and packages it for various supermarket chains.

The job is not physically demanding!

Early shift: 5:00 a.m.–1:30 p.m.

Late shift: 1:30 p.m.–10:00 p.m.

What are your responsibilities?

Are you an experienced Head Technician with strong troubleshooting skills and knowledge of mechanical, hydraulic and electrical systems? Do you work confidently in English? Apply today.As a Head Technician, Senior Mechanic or Technical Coordinator, you combine hands-on technical expertise with the daily coordination of a small team. Your main focus is diagnosing and resolving technical issues on heavy equipment. 
• Diagnose and resolve mechanical, hydraulic and electrical faults. 
• Perform assembly, disassembly and modification work on machines. 
• Carry out machine inspections and functional checks. 
• Support machine testing, commissioning and validation activities. 
• Prepare technical reports and troubleshooting guidelines. 
• Coordinate daily work planning and priorities for two mechanics. 
• Perform quality inspections and support continuous improvement initiatives.
For this position, you bring: 
• Experience in construction equipment, heavy equipment, agricultural machinery, automotive or industrial maintenance. 
• Strong mechanical knowledge. 
• Knowledge of hydraulic and electrical systems. 
• Proven experience in troubleshooting and technical fault finding. 
• Experience coordinating or guiding technicians in daily work planning. 
• Good command of English, as this is the working language. 
• Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office, including Excel and Outlook. 
• Sufficient computer skills to work with digital reporting tools and systems.

For our client, we are looking for a motivated car body technician who enjoys working with vehicles and is not afraid to get hands-on.

You will join an experienced team in a car body repair company specialized in accident damage repairs.
What will you do?
• Disassemble vehicle body parts 
• Reassemble car components after repairs 
• Work on vehicles damaged in accidents 
• Use basic tools (screws, bolts, removing and reattaching parts) 
What do we expect from you?
• Experience with cars or bodywork is an advantage 
• Strong work ethic and motivation to work 
• Careful and precise approach to tasks 
• A team player with a humble attitude Languages
• No knowledge of Dutch required 
• Basic English is sufficient for communication 
• The team already includes international workers (including Polish and Albanian colleagues)

For a family-run metal workshop specializing in the production of steel doors and windows, we are looking for a semi-automatic welder to join the team. The company is known for its high-quality finishes, attention to detail, and passion for interior design and architecture. Every project is tailor-made — from design to the finished product — with a strong focus on craftsmanship and precision.

Job description:As a semi-automatic welder, you will help produce steel doors and windows for both interior and exterior applications. You will be responsible for very fine welding work and ensure that every piece meets the highest quality standards.

Your tasks:

• 
Performing fine welding work (semi-automatic)

• 
Filing, grinding, and assembling components

• 
Cleaning and smoothing weld seams

• 
Reading and interpreting technical drawings

• 
Delivering precise, high-quality work

Profile:

• 
You have experience as a welder or are a motivated school leaver

• 
You can read and understand technical plans

• 
You have a good knowledge of Dutch or English

Are you passionate about delivering an outstanding employee technology experience? Do you enjoy acting as the bridge between business needs and IT services? Are you looking for a role where you can shape and improve the modern workplace within a growing international organization?

As Workplace Lead, you will own and continuously enhance the digital workplace environment, ensuring employees have the tools, support, and technology they need to perform at their best.You will act as the key point of contact for workplace services, driving service excellence, managing vendors, and supporting digital transformation initiatives across the business.Key Responsibilities

• Define and execute the Digital Workplace roadmap in line with business objectives.
• Ensure the reliability, performance, and continuous improvement of workplace technologies and collaboration tools.
• Manage end-user computing services, collaboration platforms, devices, and workplace-related infrastructure.
• Oversee external IT service providers and ensure agreed service levels are met.
• Monitor user satisfaction, identify areas for improvement, and implement best practices to enhance the employee experience.
• Lead workplace-related projects, including technology rollouts, migrations, and process improvements.
• Collaborate closely with business stakeholders to understand operational needs and translate them into effective technology solutions.
• Support IT governance, cybersecurity, and compliance initiatives related to workplace services.
• Manage budgets and contracts within the workplace domain.
• Contribute to shaping a modern, efficient, and user-centric technology environment.
 

Profile

• Several years of experience in Digital Workplace, End-User Services, IT Operations, or Workplace Management.
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365, collaboration platforms, device management, and modern workplace technologies.
• Experience managing third-party vendors and service providers.
• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
• Strong customer-service mindset with a focus on delivering high-quality user experiences.
• Ability to work autonomously in a fast-paced, international environment.
• Fluent in English; additional European languages are considered a plus.

Responsibilities

• Perform technical analysis and design for data exchange services and REST APIs to ensure system integration.
• Develop robust application components using PHP and JavaScript to support architectural evolution.
• Modernize strategic solutions by integrating new functionalities related to AI and data analysis.
• Collaborate with development teams to define technical architecture and ensure secure, interoperable outcomes.
• Participate in the full development lifecycle within a DevOps and Agile environment.

Requirements

• 3+ years of experience in backend and frontend development using PHP and JavaScript.
• 3+ years of experience designing and implementing REST APIs and Web Services.
• 3+ years of experience working with SQL, NoSQL, and PostgreSQL databases.
• 3+ years of experience with OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, and JWT-Based Tokens.
• 3+ years of experience in Software Architecture and applying Design Principles and patterns.
• 3+ years of experience with Containerization and DevOps workflows, specifically using GitLab.
• 3+ years of experience implementing Security By Design and application security protocols.
• You are proactive, autonomous, and possess strong problem-solving skills with a focus on quality.
• You are native in French or Dutch with passive knowledge of the other and have active knowledge of English.
Nice to Haves

• 1+ years of experience with automated testing.

You will 
support the 
implementation of the Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR) within our European logistics network. By 
working closely with suppliers and internal stakeholders, you will ensure that packaging processes comply with 
legal requirements and meet established project objectives. 

 
• Track and monitor suppliers’ compliance with the Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR) to ensure project deadlines are met on time. 
 
• Organize and facilitate online meetings with suppliers. 
 
• Discussing and clarifying different types of packaging and the roles and responsibilities of suppliers. 
 
• Explaining the PPWR requirements and expectations regarding compliance. 
 
• Coordinating implementation plans and setting target dates for execution. 
 
• Closely monitoring suppliers’ corrective actions and implementation plans, including tracking progress, milestones, and deadlines. 
 
• Preparing weekly reports for management on suppliers’ compliance status. 
 
• Identifying risks, areas of concern, and escalations that require further management support. 
 
• Conducting compliance audits and checks on manufacturer labels within warehouse operations. 
 
• Verifying that packaging and labeling processes comply with applicable PPWR guidelines and internal quality standards. 
 
• Actively contributing to a compliant, efficient, and sustainable supply chain within the logistics operation.  

Education and Relevant Experience:  

 
• You hold a bachelor’s degree in a technical, logistics, or business-related field. 
 
• Experience with sustainable packaging solutions is a plus.  
 
Competencies & Skills:  

 
• You communicate fluently in English, both verbally and in writing. 
 
• You have strong communication skills and know how to interact professionally with various stakeholders. 
 
• You have a good knowledge of Excel and are proficient in using SharePoint. Knowledge of Access and Power BI for data analysis and tracking is a plus. 
 
• You are able to manage multiple vendors, tasks, and deadlines simultaneously. 
 
• You work in a structured manner and have strong organizational and prioritization skills. 
 
• You are meticulous, reliable, and able to work independently. 
 
• You take initiative and proactively follow up on tasks to achieve set objectives. 
 
• You are motivated to further develop yourself and are determined to achieve challenging goals. 
 
• You base your recommendations and decisions on facts and feedback. 
 
• You have strong planning and organizational skills. 
 
• You enjoy working as part of a team, show respect for others, and believe in people’s growth. 
 
• You combine a positive attitude and a sense of humor with a strong work ethic. 
 
• You constantly contribute ideas for improvements and actively seek ways to optimize processes.
